description: GARANȚII FINANCIARE - ODA is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Portal Moldova, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Violeta Perlog. The dataset presents data on financial guarantees provided by the Organisation for the Development of Entrepreneurship (ODA) in the quarter. It includes information on the number of guarantees granted, the number of beneficiaries and the value of financial guarantees granted in various administrative-territorial units of the Republic of Moldova. Coverage: Violeta Perlog. The portal shows the English title as "FINANCIAL GUARANTEE - ODA" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Violeta Perlog. Its keywords include IMM-uri, Garanții financiare, Beneficiari, ODA, Finanțare publică. The listing shows 3 download or service links in XLSX, CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-government-open-data-portal-moldova.
